items.title: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium
items.summary: Gov. Greg Abbott (R) instructed PUCT and ERCOT to pause all data center applications until they complete an audit on all the information that data center developers must submit. The move reportedly came after PUCT asked 377 data center operators to submit water and power use, of which only 28 complied.
items.title_original: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium

items.title_bilingual: Texas slams on the breaks for 1,800 data centers, power grid requirements are five times higher than peak record demand — 474 gigawatts of power requests are now subject to new moratorium
items.summary_zh: 州长 Greg Abbott（共和党）指示 PUCT 和 ERCOT 暂停所有数据中心应用程序，直到完成对数据中心开发人员必须提交的所有信息的审核。据报道，此举是在 PUCT 要求 377 家数据中心运营商提交水和电力使用情况后做出的，其中只有 28 家遵守了规定。
